LESSON: HELPING THE NEEDY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The life of Jesus Christ:
Topic 3.7: Helping the Needy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Helping the Needy
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you help those in need?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the importance of helping the needy
2. demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need
3. recite Mathew 5:42 and help those in need promptly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state the importance of helping the needy

Teach
• Today’s focus: state the importance of helping the needy.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “state the importance of helping the needy” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state the importance of helping the needy" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: recite Mathew 5:42 and help those in need promptly

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state the importance of helping the needy
• Model 2: demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need
• Model 3: recite Mathew 5:42 and help those in need promptly

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state the importance of helping the needy
2. Practise: demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need
3. Practise: recite Mathew 5:42 and help those in need promptly

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Helping the Needy.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you help those in need?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need
• recite Mathew 5:42 and help those in need promptly
